name: Employee Ask AI - Authorized PDF Reader

parameters.content:
## Setup
Select Header Auth x-employee-ai-secret (same server secret as classifier). Select Gemini Query Auth parameter key. Set N8N_EMPLOYEE_AI_PAYSLIP_URL to this production webhook URL.

## Boundary
The authenticated app server supplies ONLY its authorized PDF and a random request ID. This workflow must never fetch files from user-provided URLs or connect to Supabase. PDF content is sent to Google Gemini. Disable retention in instance logs/proxies as appropriate. No pinned payslips. The server independently checks fields, owner name, cutoff and arithmetic before displaying an answer. Activate only after configuration and privacy tests.
